summary: Implemented the Databricks OAuth profile mapping. Added cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py with DatabricksOauthProfileMapping (required fields host, schema, http_path, client_id, client_secret; secret fields client_secret and client_id; mapping login/extra.client_id and password/extra.client_secret; profile sets auth_type oauth and env-var references for both secrets). Exported it from cosmos/profiles/databricks/__init__.py and cosmos/profiles/__init__.py, and registered it in profile_mappings directly after DatabricksTokenProfileMapping. Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py covering claim checks, token-over-OAuth selection, OAuth selection, profile output, override protection, and env vars. Nothing was run or committed, so the tests are unverified. One open point: env_vars uses the base get_dbt_value, so a profile arg for client_id or client_secret changes the environment value.
